Expert diagnosis and personalised treatment plans for hair loss, hair thinning, dandruff, alopecia, scalp problems, and other hair-related concerns at Neo Follicle Transplant Clinic.

Hair loss is not the same for everyone. Some people notice gradual thinning, some develop bald patches, some experience sudden hair fall, while others struggle with dandruff, scalp irritation, or poor hair density.

Led by Dr. Sandeep Mahapatra, Senior Dermatologist and Hair Transplant Surgeon, our clinic offers medical, non-surgical, and hair restoration solutions based on your condition, stage of hair loss, scalp health, age, lifestyle, and expectations.

Why Hair Conditions Need Proper Diagnosis

The First Step Is Not Treatment. It Is Diagnosis.

Hair fall, baldness, and scalp issues can look similar, but their causes may be very different.

Many patients start using shampoos, oils, supplements, or online remedies without knowing why they are losing hair. This can delay the right treatment and allow the condition to progress.

Hair loss may happen due to genetics, hormonal changes, stress, nutritional deficiencies, dandruff, autoimmune conditions, medications, lifestyle factors, or scalp inflammation. In some patients, more than one factor may be responsible.

That is why a proper hair and scalp consultation is important. At Neo Follicle Hair Transplant Clinic, we assess your pattern of hair loss, scalp condition, hair density, family history, medical history, and treatment goals before recommending the next step.

Schedule a Hair Loss Diagnosis Consultation

Male Pattern Baldness Treatment in Bangalore

For men experiencing receding hairline, crown thinning, temple recession, or progressive baldness.

Male pattern baldness, also called androgenetic alopecia, is one of the most common causes of hair loss in men. It usually begins with a receding hairline, thinning at the crown, or gradual loss of density on the top of the scalp.

In early stages, medical treatments and regenerative therapies may help slow progression and improve hair quality. In advanced stages, hair transplant may be considered to restore the hairline and improve coverage.

At Neo Follicle, the treatment plan is based on the stage of baldness, donor area strength, age, hairline expectations, and long-term maintenance needs.

Explore Male Hair Loss Treatment Options
Call # +91 - 97312 07940

Female Hair Loss & Hair Thinning Treatment

For women experiencing hair thinning, widening partition, reduced volume, or excessive shedding.

Hair loss in women can be emotionally distressing because it often affects confidence, styling, and self-image. Female hair loss may appear as diffuse thinning, widening of the central partition, reduced ponytail volume, or visible scalp.

The causes may include hormonal changes, thyroid imbalance, iron deficiency, stress, post-pregnancy changes, PCOS, menopause, crash dieting, or genetic tendency.

At Neo Follicle, female hair loss is evaluated carefully before treatment is recommended. The goal is to identify the cause, stabilise hair fall, improve scalp health, and support better hair density wherever possible.

Alopecia Areata Treatment in Bangalore

For patients with sudden round bald patches on the scalp, beard, eyebrows, or other hair-bearing areas.

Alopecia areata is a condition where the immune system affects the hair follicles, leading to sudden patchy hair loss. It may appear as one or more round bald patches on the scalp, beard, eyebrows, or body.

This condition requires dermatological evaluation because treatment depends on the size, location, duration, and progression of the patches. Some patients may recover well with timely medical care, while others may require a longer treatment and monitoring plan.

Neo Follicle offers diagnosis and treatment guidance for alopecia areata with a dermatologist-led approach.

Consult for Patchy Hair Loss
Call # +91 - 97312 07940

Sudden Hair Fall Treatment in Bangalore

For people noticing excessive hair fall after stress, illness, weight loss, fever, childbirth, or nutritional deficiency.

Sudden hair fall can be alarming. Patients may notice more hair on the pillow, bathroom floor, comb, or while washing hair. In many cases, this type of shedding may be related to stress, illness, surgery, fever, crash dieting, post-pregnancy changes, iron deficiency, thyroid issues, or lifestyle disturbances.

This condition is often manageable when the trigger is identified early. The treatment may include correcting deficiencies, improving nutrition, reducing scalp inflammation, using appropriate medicines, and monitoring regrowth.

At Neo Follicle Hair Transplant Clinic, we help patients understand whether their hair fall is temporary, progressive, or part of a larger hair loss condition.

Find the Cause of Sudden Hair Fall
Call # +91 - 97312 07940

Dandruff, Itchy Scalp & Scalp Flaking Treatment

For patients with flakes, itching, oily scalp, redness, irritation, or recurrent dandruff.

Dandruff is not just a cosmetic concern. In some patients, it may be associated with itching, scalp inflammation, oily scalp, flaking, redness, and increased hair fall. Recurrent dandruff may also indicate seborrheic dermatitis or other scalp conditions.

Using random anti-dandruff shampoos may give temporary relief, but persistent dandruff needs proper scalp evaluation. Treatment depends on the severity, scalp type, recurrence pattern, and associated symptoms.

Neo Follicle Hair Transplant Clinic provides dermatologist-guided dandruff and scalp care treatment to reduce symptoms and improve scalp health.

Get Treatment for Dandruff & Itchy Scalp
Call # +91 - 97312 07940

Receding Hairline Treatment in Bangalore

For men and women concerned about a changing hairline, temple recession, or forehead widening.

A receding hairline is often one of the earliest visible signs of patterned hair loss. It can make the forehead look broader and may change the overall facial appearance.

Treatment depends on whether the hairline recession is early, moderate, or advanced. In some cases, medicines and regenerative treatments may help maintain existing hair. In other cases, hair transplant may be required to recreate a natural-looking hairline.

At Neo Follicle Hair Transplant Clinic, hairline restoration is planned carefully with attention to age, face shape, donor hair availability, future hair loss pattern, and natural density.

Discuss Hairline Restoration Options
Call # +91 - 97312 07940

Crown Hair Thinning Treatment in Bangalore

For patients noticing visible scalp, circular thinning, or baldness on the crown area.

Crown thinning can progress slowly and may not be noticed until the scalp becomes clearly visible from the back or top. It is commonly associated with male pattern baldness but may also occur in women.

The treatment plan depends on the density of existing hair, the size of the thinning area, scalp visibility, and the progression of hair loss. Early intervention may help preserve existing hair. In advanced cases, hair transplant may be planned to improve coverage.

Neo Follicle Hair Transplant Clinic evaluates crown thinning with both short-term improvement and long-term maintenance in mind.

Evaluate Crown Hair Thinning

Patchy Beard & Low Beard Density Treatment

For men with uneven beard growth, gaps in the beard, scars, or poor facial hair density.

Some men naturally have low beard density, while others may have patchy beard growth due to genetics, alopecia areata, scars, burns, acne marks, or previous injury.

Depending on the cause, treatment may include medical management or beard transplant. In beard transplant, hair follicles are usually taken from the donor area of the scalp and implanted into the beard region to improve density and shape.

At Neo Follicle Hair Transplant Clinic, beard restoration is planned according to face shape, beard design, density requirement, and natural direction of hair growth.

Explore Beard Restoration Options
Call # +91 - 97312 07940

Eyebrow Thinning & Eyebrow Hair Loss Treatment

For people with thin eyebrows, gaps, scars, over-plucked brows, or eyebrow hair loss.

Eyebrows play an important role in facial expression and appearance. Eyebrow hair loss may occur due to over-plucking, scars, burns, alopecia areata, aging, medical conditions, or naturally thin eyebrow growth.

Treatment depends on the cause and the amount of restoration required. In selected cases, eyebrow restoration may be considered to improve shape and density.

At Neo Follicle Hair Transplant Clinic, eyebrow restoration is planned with attention to natural direction, angle, density, and facial balance.

Consult for Eyebrow Restoration

Failed Hair Transplant Repair in Bangalore

For patients unhappy with a previous hair transplant result, poor density, unnatural hairline, visible gaps, or scarring.

A failed or unsatisfactory hair transplant can affect both appearance and confidence.

Common concerns include an unnatural hairline, poor graft survival, low density, pluggy-looking hair, wrong hair direction, visible scars, or overharvested donor area.

Repair planning needs experience because the donor area may already be limited.

At Neo Follicle Hair Transplant Clinic, corrective planning focuses on what can be realistically improved, how to use available donor hair carefully, and how to create a more natural-looking outcome.

Scalp Micropigmentation for Visible Scalp & Low Density Look

Scalp Micropigmentation for Visible Scalp & Low Density Look

Scalp micropigmentation is a cosmetic technique that uses micro-pigments to create the appearance of hair follicles on the scalp.

It may help patients with visible scalp, low density appearance, scars, or those who prefer a close-shaved look.

It is not a hair growth treatment, but it can improve the visual impression of density in suitable cases.

It may also be considered along with hair transplant planning in selected patients.

Get a clear, personalized estimate based on your graft requirement, baldness grade, donor area quality, and the hair transplant technique suitable for you.

Hair transplant cost in Bangalore mainly depends on the number of grafts required. It can also vary based on your stage of hair loss, donor hair strength, hairline design, density expectations, and the technique used.

At Neo Follicle Transplant Clinic, we do not recommend a one-size-fits-all package. Your cost is estimated after a detailed scalp and donor area assessment, so the treatment plan is designed for natural-looking results, safe donor usage, and long-term value.

Why Hair Transplant Cost Is Different for Every Patient

Hair transplant pricing is not the same for everyone because every person has a different pattern of hair loss, donor hair availability, and restoration goal.

Two people may have the same level of visible baldness, but their hair transplant cost can still be different. This is because the final cost depends on how many grafts are needed, how strong the donor area is, how much density is possible, and which technique is suitable for the patient.

A good hair transplant plan is not just about covering bald areas. It should also protect the donor area, create a natural-looking hairline, and plan for future hair loss. That is why a proper scalp assessment is important before deciding the exact cost.

At Neo Follicle Transplant Clinic, the cost estimate is prepared only after understanding your hair loss pattern, donor area quality, expected coverage, and long-term hair restoration goals.

1. Number of Grafts Required

The more grafts needed to cover the thinning or bald area, the higher the overall cost may be.

2. Grade of Baldness

Early hairline recession usually needs fewer grafts, while advanced baldness or crown thinning may need a larger graft plan.

3. Donor Area Quality

A strong donor area allows better planning. If donor hair is limited, the treatment strategy has to be more careful.

4. Hairline Design

A natural-looking hairline needs proper angle, direction, density, and artistic planning.

5. Technique Used

FUE, implant pen technique, NFT Method, beard transplant, and repair procedures may have different cost structures.

6. Density Expectations

Some patients need basic coverage, while others want higher density. This can change the number of grafts required.
Important: A lower quote may not always mean better value. Hair transplant is a medical and aesthetic procedure where planning, safety, surgeon expertise, and natural-looking results matter as much as cost.

Hair Transplant Cost Per Graft in Bangalore

Most hair transplant estimates are based on the number of grafts required to cover your thinning or bald areas naturally.

Hair transplant cost in Bangalore is commonly calculated on a per-graft basis. A graft is the transplant unit taken from the donor area and placed into the thinning or bald area. Each graft may contain multiple follicles, depending on your natural follicle grouping.

At Neo Follicle Transplant Clinic, the cost range is generally ₹60 to ₹100 per graft. The exact cost may vary based on the surgeon’s experience, number of grafts required, technique used, donor area quality, density planning, and overall case complexity.

For example, a smaller hairline correction may need fewer grafts, while crown restoration or advanced baldness may require a larger session with more grafts and follicles. That is why the final estimate is best given after a detailed scalp and donor area assessment.

Term What It Means
Graft The transplant unit extracted from the donor area and implanted into the thinning or bald area
Follicle The individual follicle unit contained within grafts
Cost Per Graft The price calculated for each graft transplanted
Total Cost Cost per graft × total number of grafts required
Graft Planning Estimating the right number of grafts needed for coverage, density, and natural-looking results
Important Note: The lowest cost per graft should not be the only deciding factor. A successful hair transplant depends on correct graft planning, safe donor area usage, natural hairline design, proper implantation angle, and experienced surgical supervision.

Hair Transplant Cost Based on Baldness Grade

The stage of baldness is one of the biggest factors that decides how many grafts and follicles may be required for your hair transplant.

Hair transplant cost is closely linked to the grade of baldness. Early-stage baldness usually needs fewer grafts, while advanced baldness may need a larger number of grafts and follicles to create visible coverage.

At Neo Follicle Transplant Clinic, the doctor evaluates your baldness pattern, donor area strength, follicle availability, and future hair loss risk before estimating the number of grafts required. This helps create a treatment plan that is realistic, safe, and focused on natural-looking results.

Baldness Grade and Graft Requirement
Baldness Pattern Appx. Graft Requirement Suitable Session Type
Mild hairline recession 1000–1500 grafts ALPHA Session
Frontal hairline + temple recession 1500–2000 grafts BETA Session
Frontal baldness with mid-scalp thinning 2500–3500 grafts GAMMA Session
Crown baldness or larger thinning area 2500–4500 grafts GAMMA / MEGA Session
Advanced baldness with large coverage need 3500–4500+ grafts MEGA / GIGA Session
Note: These are approximate graft ranges. The final graft requirement can vary depending on follicle density, donor area quality, scalp laxity, graft survival planning, and the density expected by the patient.

1. Early Hairline Recession

Usually needs fewer grafts and is often planned as a smaller correction.

2. Crown Baldness

May need careful graft distribution because the crown has a circular growth pattern.

3. Advanced Baldness

Often requires larger graft planning and sometimes staged treatment.

4. Donor Area Strength

The final plan depends not only on baldness but also on how many grafts can be safely taken from the donor area.
Important Note: Two patients with the same baldness grade may still need different graft counts. One person may have a strong donor area and thick follicles, while another may have thinner follicles or limited donor availability. This is why a proper scalp and donor assessment is important before finalizing the cost.

What Is Included & Excluded in the Hair Transplant Cost?

When patients compare hair transplant cost in Bangalore, it is important to understand what the quoted price includes.

A hair transplant is not only about placing grafts. It involves consultation, scalp assessment, donor area evaluation, graft planning, hairline design, extraction, implantation, and post-procedure guidance.

At Neo Follicle Transplant Clinic, the cost estimate is explained after evaluating your baldness grade, donor area strength, number of grafts required, and expected follicle coverage. This helps you understand the treatment plan clearly before the procedure.

However, some additional services may not be included in the basic graft-based pricing. These are usually discussed during consultation, so you clearly understand what is part of the procedure cost and what may be additional. This helps you plan your treatment with complete transparency and avoid confusion later.

How Neo Follicle Estimates Your Hair Transplant Cost

Your cost estimate is prepared after assessing your baldness grade, graft requirement, follicle availability, donor area strength, and expected coverage.

At Neo Follicle Transplant Clinic, hair transplant cost is not decided by guesswork. The doctor first evaluates your scalp, donor area, baldness pattern, follicle density, and restoration goals. Based on this assessment, the required number of grafts and follicles is estimated.

This helps the clinic recommend the right session type, such as ALPHA, BETA, GAMMA, MEGA, or GIGA, depending on your graft requirement. The final estimate is then explained clearly before the procedure, so you understand the expected cost, inclusions, and possible additional requirements if any.

The aim is to give you a transparent cost plan while also protecting donor area safety and planning for natural-looking results.

Our Cost Estimation Process

1. Scalp Assessment

The doctor checks your baldness pattern, thinning areas, and scalp condition.

2. Donor Area Evaluation

The donor area is examined to understand how many grafts can be safely extracted.

3. Graft Requirement Calculation

The approximate number of grafts and follicles required for coverage is estimated.

4. Hairline & Density Planning

The frontal line, coverage area, and density expectations are discussed.

5. Session Type Recommendation

Based on graft count, the suitable ALPHA, BETA, GAMMA, MEGA, or GIGA session is suggested.

6. Cost Explanation

The doctor or clinic team explains the estimated cost, inclusions, and any possible add-ons.

7. Treatment Plan Finalization

Once you are clear and comfortable, the procedure plan is finalized.
Important Note: A proper cost estimate should include both medical and aesthetic planning. The number of grafts is important, but donor area safety, follicle handling, hairline design, and long-term planning are equally important for a good result.

FAQs - Hair Transplant Cost in Bangalore

Here are answers to common questions patients ask before planning a hair transplant at Neo Follicle Transplant Clinic.

1. What is the cost of hair transplant in Bangalore?

At Neo Follicle Transplant Clinic, hair transplant cost generally ranges from ₹60 to ₹100 per graft. The final cost depends on the number of grafts required, follicle availability, baldness grade, donor area strength, surgeon experience, and case complexity.

2. How is hair transplant cost calculated?

Hair transplant cost is usually calculated based on the number of grafts required. The basic formula is:

Total Cost = Number of Grafts Required × Cost Per Graft

For example, if a patient needs 2000 grafts, the total cost will depend on the per-graft rate recommended after consultation.

3. What is the cost of 1000 grafts in Bangalore?

At a price range of ₹60 to ₹100 per graft, 1000 grafts may cost approximately ₹60,000 to ₹1,00,000. The final estimate may vary depending on surgeon experience, donor area quality, technique, and treatment planning.

4. What is the cost of 2000 grafts in Bangalore?

At a price range of ₹60 to ₹100 per graft, 2000 grafts may cost approximately ₹1,20,000 to ₹2,00,000. A consultation is needed to confirm whether 2000 grafts are enough for your baldness pattern and density goals.

5. What is the cost of 3000 grafts in Bangalore?

At a price range of ₹60 to ₹100 per graft, 3000 grafts may cost approximately ₹1,80,000 to ₹3,00,000. This may usually fall under a larger session depending on your graft requirement and follicle coverage needs.

6. How many follicles are there in one graft?

One graft may contain more than one follicle. At Neo Follicle Transplant Clinic, session ranges are explained using both grafts and follicles. For example, 1000–1500 grafts may approximately contain 2000–3000 follicles, depending on the patient’s natural follicle grouping.

7. Why does hair transplant cost vary from person to person?

Cost varies because each patient has a different baldness grade, graft requirement, donor area strength, follicle density, scalp condition, and density expectation. Two patients may need different plans even if their baldness looks similar from the outside.

8. Is the lowest cost per graft always better?

No. The lowest cost per graft should not be the only deciding factor. A safe and natural-looking hair transplant depends on proper graft planning, donor area protection, follicle handling, hairline design, implantation angle, and doctor supervision.

9. What is included in the hair transplant cost?

The cost usually includes doctor consultation, scalp assessment, donor area evaluation, graft requirement planning, hairline design, procedure charges, local anaesthesia, post-procedure instructions, and basic follow-up guidance. Exact inclusions are explained during consultation.

10. What is not included in the hair transplant cost?

Some items may be charged separately, such as blood tests, long-term medicines, PRP, GFC, QR678, exosome therapy, additional sessions, corrective procedures, travel, stay, or special medical clearance if required.

11. Will I need PRP or other therapies after hair transplant?

Not every patient needs additional therapies. Supportive treatments such as PRP, GFC, QR678, or exosome therapy may be suggested only when they are useful for follicle health, existing follicle maintenance, or scalp condition improvement.

12. Is hair transplant a one-time cost?

For many patients, transplanted grafts can provide long-lasting coverage. However, existing non-transplanted follicles may continue to thin over time. Some patients may need medicines, maintenance therapies, follow-up care, or a second session depending on future baldness progression.

13. Which session type is right for me?

The right session depends on your graft requirement and follicle coverage needs. Neo Follicle offers ALPHA, BETA, GAMMA, MEGA, and GIGA sessions based on the number of grafts required. The suitable session is recommended after scalp and donor area assessment.

14. Can I know my exact hair transplant cost without consultation?

An approximate range can be shared, but the exact cost needs a consultation. The doctor has to assess your baldness grade, donor area, follicle availability, graft requirement, and expected density before giving a final estimate.

15. Does Neo Follicle provide transparent cost estimates?

Yes. At Neo Follicle Transplant Clinic, the cost estimate is explained based on graft requirement, follicle coverage, session type, inclusions, and any possible additional recommendations before the procedure is planned.

PRP Hair Treatment in Bangalore

PRP, or Platelet-Rich Plasma therapy, uses the patient’s own blood-derived growth factors to support weak hair follicles and improve hair thickness in selected cases. It is commonly used for early-stage hair thinning and as a supportive treatment after hair transplant.

Best suited for: Early hair thinning, weak follicles, diffuse hair fall, maintenance therapy.

GFC Hair Treatment in Bangalore

GFC, or Growth Factor Concentrate therapy, is an advanced regenerative hair treatment where concentrated growth factors are prepared from the patient’s blood and injected into the scalp. It is designed to support hair follicle activity and improve hair density in suitable patients.

Best suited for: Hair thinning, early hair loss, patients looking for a more concentrated growth factor treatment.

QR678 Hair Treatment in Bangalore

QR678 is a non-surgical hair regrowth treatment that uses a specific formulation of growth factors to support hair follicle function. It may be considered for patients with early to moderate hair loss depending on their diagnosis and suitability.

Best suited for: Androgenetic alopecia, thinning hair, early-stage hair loss.

Best suited for: Patients seeking advanced regenerative hair restoration options after dermatologist assessment.

Frequently Asked Questions

Still wondering if hair restoration is right for you? Here are clear answers from the Best Hair Transplant Clinic in Bangalore to help you make an informed decision.

Which is the best hair loss treatment in Bangalore?

The best hair loss treatment depends on the cause and stage of hair loss. PRP, GFC, QR678, exosomes, stem cell therapy, LLLT, medications, dandruff treatment, alopecia treatment, SMP, or hair transplant may be recommended after proper diagnosis.

Can hair loss be treated without hair transplant?

Yes. Early-stage hair loss, thinning, dandruff-related hair fall, alopecia areata, and weak follicles may be managed with non-surgical treatments. However, if follicles are permanently lost in bald areas, hair transplant may be required.

Is PRP better or GFC better for hair loss?

Both PRP and GFC are regenerative treatments, but they are prepared differently. The right choice depends on your hair loss pattern, follicle health, previous treatment history, and doctor’s assessment.

Does QR678 help in hair regrowth?

QR678 may help selected patients with early to moderate hair loss. It is important to consult a qualified hair loss doctor to understand whether you are suitable for this treatment.

Is exosome therapy good for hair loss?

Exosome therapy is an advanced regenerative treatment option. It may be considered for selected patients after evaluating the scalp, follicle condition, and stage of hair loss.

Can dandruff cause hair fall?

Dandruff can contribute to itching, inflammation, scratching, and scalp irritation, which may worsen hair fall. Treating dandruff medically can improve scalp health and support better hair growth conditions.

What is the difference between alopecia and normal hair fall?

Normal hair fall usually appears as diffuse shedding, while alopecia can refer to different types of hair loss, including patchy hair loss, autoimmune hair loss, or pattern baldness. A dermatologist can help identify the exact type.

When is hair transplant needed?

Hair transplant may be needed when hair follicles are permanently lost in bald areas and non-surgical treatments are unlikely to regrow hair. It is usually considered for advanced male or female pattern baldness.

Is scalp micropigmentation a hair regrowth treatment?

No. Scalp micropigmentation does not regrow hair. It is a cosmetic procedure that creates the appearance of better density or a shaved scalp look using micro-pigmentation.

How do I know which hair loss treatment is right for me?

The right treatment can be decided only after evaluating your hair loss pattern, scalp condition, medical history, hair density, and follicle health. A consultation with a dermatologist or hair transplant surgeon is the best first step.

Hair loss in women is more common than most people think—and it can happen at any age. Some of the most common causes include:

  • Hormonal changes (pregnancy, PCOS, menopause)
  • Genetics or family history
  • Nutritional deficiencies or anemia
  • Thyroid imbalances or medical conditions
  • Chronic stress or illness
  • Excessive styling, heat, or chemical treatments

Women often experience diffuse thinning—where the scalp starts to show through—or a widening part line, which can be emotionally distressing.

You may be a great candidate for a hair transplant if:

  • You have localized hair thinning or visible bald patches
  • Your donor area (usually the back of the scalp) is healthy and dense
  • You’re in good general health
  • You’ve tried non-surgical options and want a permanent solution
  • You're looking for a natural-looking, long-term fix without constant treatments

Healing is Simple. Growth is Natural. Confidence is Inevitable.

2. Shedding Phase (Totally Normal!) : In the first few weeks, the transplanted hair may shed. Don’t panic—it’s a normal part of the process. The follicles are just settling in and getting ready to grow.

3. New Growth Starts in 3–4 Months : You’ll start to see fine new hairs growing around the third or fourth month. Over time, these will thicken and blend seamlessly with your natural hair.

4. Full Results by 9–12 Months : It takes about a year to see the full transformation. Your hair will continue to grow, and the results will look completely natural—because it’s your own hair.

5. Low Maintenance : No special shampoos or treatments are needed. You can wash, style, and tie your hair like you always did—just with more volume and confidence!

A Fuller Head of Hair. A Fuller Life of Confidence.

1. Natural, Permanent Hair Regrowth : The hair that grows after the transplant is your own—so it looks, feels, and behaves just like it always did. And it stays with you for life.

2. Restores Volume & Density : Whether your part line is widening or the crown is thinning, a hair transplant can restore thickness and fill in those areas with precision.

3. Boosts Confidence & Self-Esteem : Hair loss can affect how you see yourself. With your hair restored, you’ll feel more like you—inside and out.

4. Low Maintenance, Everyday Ease : No wigs, no extensions, no constant treatments. Once your hair is back, you just enjoy it like before.

5. Safe, Minimally Invasive Procedure : The process is gentle, with no stitches or hospital stays. Most women resume normal life within days.

6. Custom-Designed Just for Women : We understand female hair patterns, aesthetics, and needs. Every procedure is planned with care and precision.

Why Hair Transplant Cost Is Different for Every Patient

Hair transplant pricing is not the same for everyone because every person has a different pattern of hair loss, donor hair availability, and restoration goal.

At Neo Follicle Transplant Clinic, we do not recommend a one-size-fits-all package. Your cost is estimated after a detailed scalp and donor area assessment, so the treatment plan is designed for natural-looking results, safe donor usage, and long-term value.

1. Number of Grafts Required

The more grafts needed to cover the thinning or bald area, the higher the overall cost may be.

2. Grade of Baldness

Early hairline recession usually needs fewer grafts, while advanced baldness or crown thinning may need a larger graft plan.

3. Donor Area Quality

A strong donor area allows better planning. If donor hair is limited, the treatment strategy has to be more careful.

4. Hairline Design

A natural-looking hairline needs proper angle, direction, density, and artistic planning.

5. Technique Used

FUE, implant pen technique, NFT Method, beard transplant, and repair procedures may have different cost structures.

6. Density Expectations

Some patients need basic coverage, while others want higher density. This can change the number of grafts required.
Important: A lower quote may not always mean better value. Hair transplant is a medical and aesthetic procedure where planning, safety, surgeon expertise, and natural-looking results matter as much as cost.

Hair Transplant Cost Per Graft in Bangalore

Most hair transplant estimates are based on the number of grafts required to cover your thinning or bald areas naturally.

Hair transplant cost in Bangalore is commonly calculated on a per-graft basis. A graft is the transplant unit taken from the donor area and placed into the thinning or bald area. Each graft may contain multiple follicles, depending on your natural follicle grouping.

At Neo Follicle Transplant Clinic, the cost range is generally ₹60 to ₹100 per graft. The exact cost may vary based on the surgeon’s experience, number of grafts required, technique used, donor area quality, density planning, and overall case complexity.

For example, a smaller hairline correction may need fewer grafts, while crown restoration or advanced baldness may require a larger session with more grafts and follicles. That is why the final estimate is best given after a detailed scalp and donor area assessment.

Term What It Means
Graft The transplant unit extracted from the donor area and implanted into the thinning or bald area
Follicle The individual follicle unit contained within grafts
Cost Per Graft The price calculated for each graft transplanted

Graft Planning Estimating the right number of grafts needed for coverage, density, and natural-looking results

FAQs on Hair Transplant in Bangalore

Yes, hair transplants offer a long-term solution. The transplanted hair is taken from areas genetically resistant to hair loss (usually the back of the scalp), making it permanent and natural-looking. However, maintaining overall scalp health post-procedure is still important.

Most hair transplants are performed under local anesthesia, so the procedure itself is not painful. Patients may experience mild discomfort or tightness in the days following the surgery, which is typically manageable with pain relievers.

Hair transplant results are gradual. You may see initial shedding within 2–4 weeks, new hair growth in 3–4 months, and full visible results in 9–12 months. Patience is key as your new hair follicles establish and grow.

Downtime is minimal. Most patients can return to work within 2–5 days after the procedure, depending on the type of technique used. However, strenuous physical activity should be avoided for 10–14 days.

Yes, when performed by a skilled and experienced surgeon, hair transplants can deliver a very natural look. Modern techniques like Follicular Unit Extraction (FUE) and Direct Hair Transplantation (DHT) allow precise placement of hair follicles, matching your natural hair growth pattern and hairline design.

In many cases, yes—but only after proper evaluation. Controlled diabetes and blood pressure are not usually barriers, but it's important to share your medical history with the hair transplant doctor. At Neo Follicle Hair Transplant in Bangalore we conduct a thorough pre-op health screening to ensure you're fit for the procedure.

At Neo Follicle, we offer advanced techniques like FUE (Follicular Unit Extraction), scarring is minimal and virtually invisible to the naked eye, even with short hair. However, older methods like FUT (strip method) may leave a linear scar at the donor site. Choosing the right technique and experienced surgeon is key to reducing scarring.

While success rates are generally high, a hair transplant can fail due to poor surgical technique, inadequate post-operative care, or underlying health issues. Choosing a qualified and experienced hair transplant surgeon in Bangalore significantly reduces this risk. Following post-surgery instructions is equally important.

Hair transplants are generally safe, but like any procedure, they carry some risks. These may include temporary swelling, redness, mild pain, itching, or infection (rare if done in hygienic conditions). These side effects are usually minor and subside within a few days to weeks.

Yes, Dr Sandeep Mahapatra recommends combining hair transplant procedures with Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP) therapy. PRP can help speed up healing, improve graft survival, and boost the growth of existing thinning hair, making it a great complementary treatment.

How Does It Work?

Complete the assessment in 3 easy steps!

Take A Photo

Take a high-resolution photo of your scalp in good light and upload it. Focus on the area you want to analyze with our tool. High-quality images are essential for accurate analysis. We recommend using your smartphone's camera.

Wait for the AI to analyze your images!

Let the artificial intelligence analyze your hair condition using a database of over 15,000 images. Al will examine your photos, identify your hair condition, and accurately determine your current stage of hair loss.

Get Your Report

Get a detailed report describing the possible causes of your hair loss and the solutions that are proven to be the most effective based on current research. It also provides a estimate of numbers of graft and the cost of hair transplant.

I did my hair transplant on 6th of June. I have glad to share my experience, so, before hair transplant I had lots of confusion wheather I am going to do or not because lots of rumours in your surrounding.

Then I planned to visit neo follicles and I met Dr Sandeep Mahapatra, trust me I cleared all my doubts and fixed the date for hair transplant.

The procedure was going very smoothly and the staffs were very kind and polite . I didn't feel any pain during the procedure.They explained me proper steps pre and post HT.

What is a Body Hair Transplant?

When the Scalp Can’t Donate—The Body Steps In

Body hair transplant (BHT) uses hairs from areas like the beard, chest, or back to fill in scalp baldness, especially when scalp donor supply is limited.
In a body hair transplant, grafts are taken from areas such as the beard, chest, shoulders, or back and implanted into balding areas on the scalp.

It’s especially helpful for patients with advanced hair loss, poor scalp donor density, or those needing repair procedures after failed transplants.

The technique is performed using FUE, ensuring minimal scarring and natural-looking results.

How Body Hair Transplant Works

A Precision Procedure That Maximizes Every Graft

We extract healthy grafts from body areas using FUE and implant them into your scalp for improved density.
✅ Step 1: Consultation & Hair Mapping
We assess your scalp and body hair to determine which areas are suitable for graft extraction.
✅ Step 2: FUE Graft Extraction
Using tiny punch tools, we extract hair follicles from the beard, chest, or other approved donor zones.
✅ Step 3: Implantation into Scalp
Grafts are implanted into balding areas just like in a traditional transplant, with attention to direction and density.
✅ Step 4: Recovery & Regrowth
Mild redness fades in a few days. Results start to appear in 3–4 months and continue improving for up to a year.

What is an Unshaven Hair Transplant?

Hair Restoration That Fits Your Lifestyle

Unlike traditional methods, this technique restores your hair without fully shaving your scalp—so you can get treated without anyone knowing.
An unshaven hair transplant (also known as U-FUE) allows us to extract and implant hair follicles without shaving the recipient area or, in some cases, even the donor zone.

It’s especially popular among women, working professionals, celebrities, and anyone who values privacy during their treatment.

This technique delivers natural, permanent results—with no obvious signs of surgery.

How It Works?

The Same Trusted FUE Method—Just More Discreet

We use precision tools to extract and implant individual follicles—without shaving your head.
✅ Step 1: Hairline Planning & Area Mapping
We identify thinning zones and design a natural-looking hairline to match your current hair.
✅ Step 2: Selective Graft Extraction
Only a small portion of the donor area (at the back) is trimmed—leaving the rest of your hair untouched.
✅ Step 3: Micro-Implantation in Recipient Area
Grafts are carefully implanted along designed hairline and between existing hair strands—without shaving the area.
✅ Step 4: Recovery & Follow-Up
You can return to work in 1–2 days with no visible signs of the procedure.
✅ Step 5: Recovery & Support
You’ll receive full post-care instructions and regular follow-ups to ensure optimal results.

Uses hair from the chest, beard, or other body areas when scalp donor hair is limited. A useful option for repair cases or high-grade baldness. Helps increase coverage and density in targeted zones.

What is PRP Hair Treatment?

A Natural Boost for Your Hair—No Pills or Transplants Needed

PRP (Platelet-Rich Plasma) therapy uses your own blood to stimulate hair growth and reduce hair fall—safely and naturally.
PRP therapy involves drawing a small amount of your blood, spinning it in a special machine to concentrate the platelets and growth factors, and then injecting that enriched solution into thinning areas of your scalp.

These platelets help strengthen weak hair roots, reduce hair fall, and promote thicker hair growth.

It’s a completely non-surgical treatment, ideal for both men and women who are in the early stages of hair thinning.
At our clinic, we offer advanced PRP hair treatment in Marathahalli, Whitefield, Bangalore, performed by specialized practitioners and PRP doctors. Our team carefully monitors your progress throughout the treatment to ensure optimal results without side effects.

What is Growth Factor Concentrate (GFC) Hair Therapy?

A Natural, Non-Surgical Solution That Uses Your Body’s Healing Power

Growth Factor Concentrate (GFC) Hair Therapy is a cutting-edge, non-surgical treatment that uses the body’s own natural healing proteins to stimulate hair growth, reduce hair fall, and rejuvenate thinning areas of the scalp.
Unlike regular PRP therapy, GFC uses a special lab-based process to extract only the purest and most potent growth factors from your blood—leaving behind unnecessary components like red blood cells and plasma.

These concentrated growth proteins are then injected into areas where your hair is thinning or weakening, activating dormant follicles, improving blood flow, and promoting healthier, denser hair.

The treatment is completely safe, minimally invasive, and suitable for both men and women in the early to moderate stages of hair loss.

Many patients prefer GFC because it requires fewer sessions than traditional PRP, offers stronger results, and fits easily into a busy lifestyle with no downtime.
Whether you're seeing more hair in your brush or just want to avoid invasive procedures - Growth Factor Concentrate GFC Hair Treatment in Bangalore might be the perfect solution.

What Is Stem Cell Therapy for Hair Loss?

Your Body Already Has What It Takes to Regrow Hair

Stem cell therapy taps into your own regenerative power to kickstart hair growth in thinning or weak areas of the scalp.
Stem cell therapy is a revolutionary treatment that uses the regenerative power of stem cells to promote hair growth.

Stem cells, unique cells in the body capable of transforming into different types of cells, play a crucial role in repairing and regenerating damaged tissues.

When applied to hair follicles, these cells can stimulate hair regrowth by promoting the production of new, healthy hair follicles.

The process involves extracting stem cells from your body, typically from areas such as bone marrow or fat tissue, and injecting them into the scalp.

These stem cells work to repair damaged hair follicles, reverse the miniaturization process (shrinking of hair follicles), and encourage the growth of new hair.

What is Failed Hair Transplant Restoration?

It’s Not the End of the Road—It’s a Fresh Start

A failed transplant can feel disappointing—but the right expertise can restore both your hair and your confidence.
A failed hair transplant occurs when a previous procedure (done elsewhere) doesn’t deliver the expected results. This may include:

✅ An unnatural or uneven hairline

✅ Low graft survival rate or patchy density

✅ Visible scars or pluggy appearance

✅ Incorrect direction or angling of hair

✅ No significant hair growth even after 6–12 months

Failed hair transplant restoration involves evaluating what went wrong and designing a corrective treatment plan to fix and enhance the previous outcome.

What Is Direct Hair Transplant?

Direct hair transplant is a modern hair restoration approach where healthy hair follicles are extracted from the donor area and implanted into thinning or bald areas with careful control over angle, depth, direction, and density.

At Neo Follicle Transplant Clinic, the procedure is planned to create a natural-looking hairline, protect the donor area, support graft survival, and achieve long-term hair growth.

Why Choosing the Right Direct Hair Transplant Clinic Matters

A successful hair transplant depends on planning, donor safety, graft survival, natural hairline design, and long-term hair loss management — not just the technique name.

Direct hair transplant is a highly technique-sensitive procedure. The final result depends on how well the donor area is assessed, how carefully grafts are extracted, how naturally the hairline is designed, and how precisely the follicles are implanted.

Choosing the wrong clinic can lead to poor density, an unnatural hairline, visible gaps, overharvested donor area, poor graft survival, or the need for corrective surgery later.

At Neo Follicle Transplant Clinic, every hair transplant plan is created after evaluating the patient’s hair loss pattern, donor area strength, scalp condition, graft requirement, age, expectations, and future hair loss risk.

Donor Area Assessment

The donor area is the foundation of a good hair transplant. A careful assessment helps decide how many grafts can be safely extracted without weakening the donor region.

Natural Hairline Design

A natural hairline should match the patient’s age, face shape, existing hair pattern, and future hair loss risk. Poor hairline planning can make the result look artificial.

Safe Graft Extraction

Controlled Implantation

Types of Hair Transplant Techniques

Hair transplant techniques differ in how grafts are extracted, how recipient sites are prepared, and how follicles are implanted. At Neo Follicle, the right technique is recommended after assessing the donor area, baldness grade, scalp condition, graft requirement, and long-term hair growth plan.
Patients often come across terms like FUE, FUT, Sapphire FUE, Direct Follicle Implantation, and NFT Method while researching hair transplant options. These techniques are not all the same. Some describe how grafts are extracted, while others describe how the follicles are implanted.

The best technique depends on the patient’s hair loss pattern, donor area strength, expected density, cosmetic goals, and suitability after medical evaluation.

FUE Hair Transplant

FUE, or Follicular Unit Extraction, is a technique where individual hair follicles are extracted from the donor area and implanted into thinning or bald areas.

Best for: Patients looking for individual graft extraction, minimal visible donor scarring, and faster recovery compared to strip surgery.

Key benefit: No linear scar and suitable for hairline, crown, beard, eyebrow, and repair cases.

FUT Hair Transplant

FUT, or Follicular Unit Transplantation, is a strip-based technique where a thin strip of scalp is removed from the donor area and grafts are separated for implantation.

Best for: Selected patients who need a larger number of grafts and have a suitable donor area.

Key benefit: Can provide higher graft yield in selected cases.

Direct Hair Implantation

Direct Hair Implantation is an implanter-assisted technique where extracted grafts are placed directly into the recipient area with control over angle, depth, direction, and density.

Hair Transplant: Basics You Need to Know

If you're considering a hair transplant in Bangalore, you’re probably curious about what the procedure involves and how it can help restore your hair. We’re here to break it down for you in simple, easy-to-understand terms. Let’s dive into the basics!

A hair transplant is a procedure where hair follicles from one part of your scalp (usually the back or sides) are moved to areas where hair is thinning or balding. Think of it like relocating healthy, strong hair to areas where your hair is struggling. Over time, these transplanted hairs start growing in their new spots, giving you a fuller, more natural look.

A hair follicle is a tiny structure in the skin that grows hair. It contains cells that produce keratin, the protein that forms hair strands. Each follicle goes through a growth cycle, including growth, rest, and shedding.

A hair graft refers to a group of hair follicles that are transplanted from the donor area to the recipient area during a hair transplant procedure. A graft typically contains multiple follicles, usually 1 to 4, grouped together.

While a follicle is the individual structure that grows hair, a graft is the unit of hair follicles that are moved during a transplant. The success of a hair transplant relies on the survival and growth of the grafts once transplanted.

Neo Follicle offers different types of hair transplant procedures depending on the patient’s need, donor area, hair loss pattern, and aesthetic goal. Each procedure is planned after proper scalp evaluation and consultation with the doctor.

Hair Transplant For Male

Restore a natural-looking hairline and improve bald or thinning areas.

Male hair transplant is commonly performed for receding hairline, frontal baldness, crown thinning, and male pattern baldness. At Neo Follicle, the treatment plan is based on the grade of baldness, future hair loss risk, donor hair strength, and desired density.

Hair Transplant For Female

Hair restoration for women with thinning hair, visible scalp, or female pattern hair loss.

Female hair transplant requires careful diagnosis because women can experience hair loss due to hormonal, nutritional, genetic, stress-related, or medical causes. At Neo Follicle, female hair restoration is planned only after understanding the cause and suitability.

Failed Hair Transplant Repair

Correct unnatural hairlines, poor density, scarring, or previous transplant concerns.

Patients who are unhappy with an earlier hair transplant may need a detailed evaluation before repair. Neo Follicle assesses the previous graft placement, donor area condition, scalp health, and realistic correction options.

Beard Transplant

Fill patchy beard areas and improve beard shape and density.

Beard transplant is suitable for men with patchy beard growth, scars, thin moustache, or uneven facial hair. The procedure uses hair follicles from the donor area and places them carefully to match the direction and angle of natural beard growth.

Eyebrow Restoration

Restore eyebrow shape, fullness, and symmetry with precise follicle placement.

Eyebrow restoration is useful for people with thin eyebrows, over-plucked eyebrows, scars, or eyebrow hair loss. The procedure requires fine planning because eyebrow hair direction, angle, and density are very different from scalp hair.

Learn More About Eyebrow Restoration

Body Hair Transplant

An option for selected patients with limited scalp donor hair.

In some cases, body hair may be considered as an additional donor source when scalp donor hair is limited. Suitability depends on hair texture, growth cycle, body hair availability, and the goal of restoration.

Neo-Follicle Stem Cell Therapy

A regenerative hair loss treatment that activates dormant hair follicles using stem cell technology, promoting stronger and thicker hair regrowth naturally.
Learn More About Stem Cell Therapy

PRP-Platelet-Rich Plasma Therapy

A clinically proven hair regrowth therapy that uses platelet-rich plasma from your own blood to stimulate hair follicles, improve density, and slow hair loss.

Growth Factor Concentrate (GFC) Therapy

A next-generation growth factor-based treatment that enhances hair follicle strength, reduces hair thinning, and promotes long-term regrowth with zero side effects.
Learn More About GFC Treatment

Neo QR678 Treatment

A revolutionary peptide-based therapy designed to reduce hair fall and boost hair regrowth, clinically tested for both men and women suffering from hair thinning.
Learn More About QR678 Treatment

Low Level Laser Therapy (LLLT)

A non-invasive, painless laser treatment that uses low-level laser light to improve blood circulation in the scalp, enhancing hair follicle health and growth.
Learn More About LLLT

Scalp Hair Micro-Pigmentation (MPG)

A non-surgical cosmetic treatment that creates the illusion of fuller hair by using specialized pigments, ideal for camouflaging bald spots or adding scalp density.
Learn More About Scalp MPG

Exosome Therapy

A cutting-edge stem cell-derived treatment that delivers growth factors and proteins directly to hair follicles, accelerating natural hair regeneration and reducing inflammation.

Are You the Right Candidate for Hair Transplant?

Hair transplant is suitable only when the donor area, hair loss pattern, and expectations are medically appropriate.

  • Patchy beard or moustache growth
  • Thin or missing eyebrows
  • Hair loss after injury, scar, or previous surgery
  • Unsatisfactory result from an earlier hair transplant

However, hair transplant may not be the first option for every patient. If your hair loss is active, diffuse, medically driven, or temporary, the doctor may first recommend medical or non-surgical hair loss treatment.

Our website may contain links to third-party websites or applications. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those sites. We encourage you to review their privacy policies separately.


9. Social Media Sites

Our digital properties may include social media features such as Facebook®, Twitter®, You-Tube® and LinkedIn® buttons. These features may collect your IP address, which page you are visiting on our site, and may set a cookie to enable the Feature to function properly. Your interactions with these Features are governed by the privacy statement of the company providing them.


10. Billing Information

We may require the User to pay with a credit card, debit card, net banking, wallets or other online payment mechanisms for Services for which an amount(s) is/are payable. We will collect such User’s credit card number and/or other financial institution information such as bank account numbers and will use that information for the billing and payment processes, including but not limited to the use and disclosure of such credit card number and information to third parties as necessary to complete such billing operation.

Verification of credit information, however, is accomplished solely by the User through the authentication process offered by a third-party payment gateway. User’s credit card/ debit card details are transacted upon secure sites of approved payment gateways which are digitally encrypted, thereby providing the highest possible degree of care as per latest technology currently available. User is cautioned, however, that internet technology is not fool proof or safe.


11. Children Policy

Our website and services are not intended for use by individuals under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from minors without parental consent.


12. Changes to this Privacy Policy

We reserve the right to update this policy at any time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date. Continued use of our services implies your agreement to the updated terms.
